title: Tra Su half day
summary: The flooded cajuput forest, 23 km from town. Pay the gate, then the boat if the sampan is the visit you wanted.

stops.name: Tra Su cajuput forest
stops.note: Gate 120,000 VND. The boat is a separate 60,000 VND ticket on the 2024 table. Confirm it at the gate. The on-site guide is capped at 3 hours.

approach.note: 23 km from Châu Đốc. Drive minutes are check on arrival.
